collection.budget_clock: time.monotonic, frozen before the first request
collection.budget_rule: checked before every request; a request started before the cutoff keeps its terminal capture even if late; no further request starts; any budget violation makes the overall audit receipt ERROR while a complete verification bundle keeps its independently computed verdict
collection.journal: durable attempt-start entry before every decide call and a terminal capture entry immediately after; entries exist only when attempts start or captures arrive; an interruption partitions the schedule into captured, started-without-capture and unattempted

criteria: Refund_not_showing_up
A refund the customer expects has not appeared in their account.
activate_my_card
The customer wants to activate a new card.
age_limit
Minimum or maximum age to open or use an account.
apple_pay_or_google_pay
Using or adding the card with Apple Pay or Google Pay.
atm_support
Which ATMs can be used, or how to use the card at an ATM.
automatic_top_up
Setting up, changing or understanding automatic top-ups.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer
A bank transfer into the account has not updated the balance.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit
A cheque or cash deposit has not updated the balance.
beneficiary_not_allowed
A transfer was refused because the beneficiary is not allowed.
cancel_transfer
The customer wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made.
card_about_to_expire
The card is expiring soon and the customer asks about a replacement.
card_acceptance
Where or whether the card is accepted.
card_arrival
When an ordered card will arrive, or that it has not arrived.
card_delivery_estimate
How long card delivery takes or the estimated delivery time.
card_linking
Linking a card to the account or the app.
card_not_working
The card does not work when the customer tries to use it.
contract.instructions: Classify this online banking customer message into exactly one of the listed intents. Choose the single intent that best matches what the customer is asking about or reporting.
contract.name: jev-audit-banking77-16
contract.population: Banking77 (PolyAI task-specific-datasets @ 57ec275d, CC-BY-4.0): 16 of 77 intents selected by case-sensitive label sort; 320 calibration texts from the training split and 639 deduplicated verification texts from the test split, frozen before inference. A finite public benchmark subset: demo-scope descriptive evidence only; not the full 77-class task, not IID population evidence, not a powered calibration study, and no claim about label truth or absence from model training.

metrics.accepted_error: wrong ACT / all ACT; null when ACT = 0 or cohort incomplete
metrics.brier: mean over valid answers of sum over all 16 options of (normalized probability - one-hot gold)^2; range [0, 2]
metrics.cohorts: calibration and verification reported separately, never pooled
metrics.coverage: ACT / scheduled cohort size, complete cohorts only
metrics.ece: sum over nonempty bins of n_bin/n_valid * |mean p - accuracy|
metrics.null_rules: empty bins, n_valid = 0 metrics and unmeasured spend are null
metrics.reliability_bins: 10 equal-width bins on the selected-option probability p: bin i holds i/10 <= p < (i+1)/10 for i in 0..8 and 0.9 <= p <= 1 for i = 9, using Python float comparison against the edges i/10
metrics.valid_answers: every normalized ChoiceAnswer, including ABSTAIN and DENY

protocol.gold_handling: Gold labels and case ids are evaluator metadata. The HTTP body carries only the exact original text as state, the pinned model and the locked question; it never carries a case id or gold label.
protocol.summary: One frozen protocol, 959 sequential single-attempt requests (320 calibration, then 639 verification) against the pinned jev-1.13.0 target. No retry, replacement, tuning, restart or output-based selection. Calibration is a descriptive cohort, not a threshold-fitting step. Finite benchmark evidence: not IID population evidence, not the full 77-class task, no power claim, no model-training-exclusion claim.
protocol.title: Preregistered descriptive Jev audit on a 16-label Banking77 subset

review_gate: A passing --check-preregistration proves internal and current-input consistency only. Collection requires Codex's recorded review of the committed preregistration and a separate live-phase dispatch. Any later change to bound source, scripts, inputs or identity invalidates execution.

schedule.order: calibration inventory order, then verification inventory order

selection.rule: labels = first 16 of the 77 category strings in case-sensitive sort; calibration = per label in that order, first 20 training rows in original record order whose strip().casefold() text is neither a normalized test text nor already selected; verification = every test row of a selected label in original test order, first occurrence per normalized text; original text bytes are the state.
